scripts.lint: ruff check . && vulture app scripts tests --min-confidence 80 && python3 scripts/check_product_delivery.py && python3 scripts/product_versions.py check && npm run check:static-build && python3 scripts/sync_static_versions.py --check
scripts.check:security: python3 -m pip check && python3 -m bandit -q -r app scripts -c pyproject.toml && python3 -m pip_audit -r requirements-dev.txt --progress-spinner off
scripts.check:quality: npm run lint && npm run check:security
scripts.test:browser: playwright test && playwright test --config=playwright.username.config.js && playwright test --config=playwright.passkeys.config.js
